description: This file is a unit test for the NationalityDao class in the OrangeHRM project. It tests various CRUD operations related to the Nationality entity, including adding, editing, retrieving, and deleting nationalities, as well as checking for existing names.

classes.name: NationalityDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the NationalityDao data access object functions related to the Nationality entity in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, creating an instance of NationalityDao and populating the database with fixture data.

methods.name: testAddNationality
methods.description: Tests adding a new Nationality entity and verifies its persistence.

methods.name: testEditNationality
methods.description: Tests editing an existing Nationality entity and verifies the update.

methods.name: testGetNationalityList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of Nationality entities based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetNationalityById
methods.description: Tests fetching a Nationality entity by its ID.

methods.name: testGetNationalityByName
methods.description: Tests retrieving a Nationality entity by name with case insensitivity and trimming.

methods.name: testIsExistingNationalityName
methods.description: Checks the existence of a nationality name in the database, considering case insensitivity and whitespace.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Tests attempting to delete non-existing records and expects no deletions.
